RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL  ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Thursday, the December 15, 2005/Agrahayana 24, 1927 (Saka)
————
(Ministries : Prime Minister; Agro and Rural Industries; Atomic Energy; Coal;
Communications and Information Technology; External Affairs; Labour
and Employment; Ocean Development; Overseas Indian Affairs;
Personnel, Public Grievances and Pensions; Planning; Science
 and Technology; Shipping, Road Transport and Highways;
Small Scale Industries; Space; Statistics and Programme
 Implementation; Youth Affairs and Sports)
Total number of questions — 20
Roads damaged due to floods in
Mumbai
*321. SHRI TARIQ ANWAR:
SHRIMATI HEMA MALINI:
Will the Minister of SHIPPING, ROAD
TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether following the recent
unprecedented floods in Mumbai, the State
Government of Maharashtra has sought
any special technical and other aid from his
Ministry for speedy upgrading and
reconstruction of roads and bridges in
Mumbai;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) Government's response thereto?
Creation of a gene bank
*322. SHRIMATI VANGA GEETHA:
Will the Minister of SCIENCE AND
TECHNOLOGY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have any
proposal to create a gene bank for private
and public organisations;
(b) if so, the modalities worked out in
this regard so far; and
(c) the funds allocated for the current
Five Year Plan for this purpose?
Funds for roads in NE Region
*323. SHRI DWIJENDRA NATH
SHARMAH: Will the Minister of
SHIPPING, ROAD TRANSPORT AND
HIGHWAYS be pleased to state:
(a) the details of funds allotted and
utilised during the last three years in the
States of North Eastern Region under road
funds to upgrade highways and main
district roads of the NER; and
(b) the names of the roads for which
allocations had been made and the details
of the progress of works on these roads of
the region during this period?

100
Investment in ARIs
*324. SHRI MOTIUR RAHMAN:
MAULANA OBAIDULLAH
KHAN AZMI:
 Will the Minister of AGRO AND
RURAL INDUSTRIES  be pleased to state:
(a) the quantum of investments made in
agro and rural industries during the last three
years and as on date in different States,
State-wise;
(b) what are the problems of these
industries; and
(c) what strategy has been devised to
give a boost to the agro and rural industries?
State-wise teledensity
†*325. SHRI KRIPAL PARMAR:
SHRI SURENDRA LATH:
Will the Minister of
COMMUNICATIONS AND
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY be
pleased to state:
(a) the telephone density in rural and
urban areas during the last year and this
year till now, State-wise;
(b) whether the telephone density in
rural areas is less than that in urban areas;
(c) if so, the details thereof, State-wise
and the reasons therefor; and
(d) the steps taken or proposed to be
taken by Government to increase the
telephone density in rural areas particularly
in the rural areas of Orissa and Himachal
Pradesh?
Nehru Yuva Kendras in Punjab
*326. SHRI DHARAM PAL
SABHARWAL: Will the Minister of
YOUTH AFFARIS AND SPORTS be
pleased to state:
(a) the numbr of Nehru Yuva Kendras
functioning in Punjab at present, location-
wise; and
(b) the details of the programmes being
run by these Kendras during the last three
years and the current year alongwith
performance of these Kendras?
Conditions imposed by USA on
nuclear deal
*327. SHRI MANOJ
BHATTACHARYA: Will the PRIME
MINISTER be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that ever since
the Indo-US Nuclear deal was signed, the
U.S. administration has been asking for
more concessions and placing the burden
of meeting conditions associated with the
deal entirely on India;
(b) if so, details thereof; and
(c) Government's reaction thereto?
Opening of LoC for relief work
*328. SHRI SHARAD YADAV:
SHRI PYARELAL
KHANDELWAL:
 Will the PRIME MINISTER be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have decided
to open points on LoC between J&K and
PoK with a view to provide assistance to
recent earthquake victims which has hit
the region;
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

101
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
amount of assistance provided/likely to be
provided at these points for the victims,
especially for those belonging to Pok; and
(c) the number of victims who have
attended camps opened at these points and
what is their response to it?
Abolition of Administrative Tribunals
*329. SHRI AMAR SINGH:
SHRI ABU ASIM AZMI:
  Will the PRIME MINISTER be
pleased to state:
(a) whether there is any proposal under
Government's consideration to abolish the
Central Administrative Tribunals and the
States Administrative Tribunals;
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
reasons for taking such a decision; and
(c) what would be the fate of the
employees of these tribunals after their
abolition?
Guidelines on child labour

Minister of LABOUR AND
EMPLOYMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have
formulated the guidelines on child l

Total number of questions —155
554
Rural industries in North Eastern
Region
2422. SHRI DWIJENDRA NATH
SHARMAH: Will the Minister of  AGRO
AND RURAL INDUSTRIES be pleased
to state:
(a) the details of the steps being taken
by Government for development and
promotion of rural industries in the North
Eastern Region;
(b) the details of plans formulated and
being implemented in the region; and
(c) the amount sanctioned and spent
under the schemes during the last three
years?
Centrally sponsored schemes for ARIs
2423. SHRI T.T.V. DHINAKARAN:
Will the Minister of  AGRO AND RURAL
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) the details of Centrally sponsored
schemes implemented for developing agro-
rural industries;
(b) the details of funds allocated during
the last three years, State-wise; and
(c) the steps taken by Government to
protect agro-rural industries from
competition by providing technology
support?
Beneficiaries of PMRY in Andhra
Pradesh
2424. SHRIMATI N.P. DURGA: Will
the Minister of  AGRO AND RURAL
INDUSTRIES be pleased to refer to the
reply to Unstarred Question 131 given in
the Rajya Sabha on 24th November, 2005
and state:
(a) the reasons for reduction in the
number of beneficiaries in 2004-05 as
compared to 2003-04;
(b) whether Government have sent any
communication to Government of Andhra
Pradesh for not reporting utilization of
funds under Pradhan Mantri Rozgar
Yojana (PMRY) during the year under
review; and

555
(c) whether it is mandatory to send the
reports once in every quarter?
Production of items using agro and
rural resources
2425. SHRI S.S. AHLUWALIA: Will
the Minister of  AGRO AND RURAL
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) the number of units engaged in
production of various items using agro and
other rural resources, including human
resource, as inputs in various parts of the
country as on 31st March of 1997, 2000,
2003 and 2005;
(b) the details of items, majority of these
units have produced in terms of volume
and value during the above stated periods;
(c) the number of persons gainfully
engaged period-wise therein; and
(d) the steps taken, if any, for
enhancing/encouraging agro and rural
industries?
Uranium deposits
2426. SHRIMATI S.G. INDIRA: Will
the  PRIME MINISTER be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that India has
tied up the medium term fuel supplies for
nuclear energy programme of generating
13,000 m.w. of power;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether it is also a fact that  country
is developing indigenous air borne survey
instruments to locate more deposits of
Uranium; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Government dues on coal companies
2427. SHRI SHARAD YADAV: Will
the PRIME MINISTER be pleased to
state:
(a) whether a large amount of money is
to be paid by various Government owned
companies including NTPC/power plants
to public sector coal companies;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) what action has been taken/proposed
to be taken to clear the dues by Government
owned companies to these coal companies?
CBI raids in coal companies
2428. SHRI DATTA MEGHE: Will the
PRIME MINISTER be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Central Bureau of
Investigation (CBI), alongwith the vigilance
units of the organization conducted raids
on the premises of coal companies in the
country on 22nd November, 2005 for
various irregularities committed there;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the departmental action taken by
Government against the officers of coal
companies for committing various
irregularities?
Profit earned by S.E.C.L.
†2429. SHRIMATI KAMLA MANHAR:
Will the PRIME MINISTER be pleased to
state:
(a) the details of the profits of S.E.C.L.
during the last five years, year-wise; and
(b) the details of basic facilities provided
by S.E.C.L. in the affected areas during the
last five years year-wise?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

556
Supply of coal for power plant in
Maharashtra
2430. SHRI R.S. GAVAI: Will the
PRIME MINISTER be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government of
Maharashtra have asked for supply of
adequate coal of about 0.5 million MT per
year for captive power plant within
MIHAN-SEZ from Western Coalfields
Ltd;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) Government decision in this regard?
Purchase of tyres by CIL
2431. SHRIMATI S.G. INDIRA: Will
the PRIME MINISTER be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that flat tyres are
threatening to defeat CIL's plans
